page.content:
Verona tragedy of the Montague and Capulet lovers.

How Romeo and Juliet connects

  • Creator: William Shakespeare — William Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet.
  • Character: Romeo — Romeo is the Montague lover of Romeo and Juliet.
  • Character: Juliet — Juliet is the Capulet lover of Romeo and Juliet.
  • Character: Mercutio — Mercutio is Romeo's friend whose death turns the comedy toward the tomb.
  • Concept: Shakespearean tragedy — Romeo and Juliet is an early Shakespearean tragedy of the two houses.

What is Romeo and Juliet?

Romeo and Juliet is the young-lovers play: a street feud, a balcony, Mercutio's death, and the tomb that ends both houses' children.

Key threads lead to William Shakespeare, Romeo, Juliet, Mercutio and Shakespearean tragedy.
